alerts.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 8 at 1:18AM EDT until October 8 at 3:00PM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.areas: Cape Cod Bay; Nantucket Sound; Vineyard Sound; Buzzards Bay; Rhode Island Sound; Block Island Sound
alerts.description: * WHAT...Southwest winds 10 to 20 kt with gusts up to 25 kt and seas around 3 feet expected. * WHERE...Portions of Massachusetts coastal waters and Rhode Island coastal waters. * WHEN...From 9 PM this evening to 3 PM EDT Thursday. * IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
alerts.instruction: Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
